authority: preregistered response-blind net-zero deep internal redistribution state construction
scientific_question: Can a prospective net-zero internal redistribution confined below 30 cm construct opposite deep states with near-identical total and root-zone storage but materially different interface-adjacent H16, beyond the 1e-7 cm resolution ceiling of the immutable library?

forcing_semantics.headcalc_balance: qdra contributes to matrix sink; qssdi contributes to matrix source
forcing_semantics.net_forcing_mass: within each interval the only nonzero internal source and sink have exactly equal positive magnitudes; top and bottom boundary fluxes are also equal

execution_contract: each direction/fraction/step-count family starts from the same fresh B01 Se=0.85 origin
derive K0 from the fresh B01 seed before constructing q_eq and transfer magnitudes
qssdi is nonzero only at the preregistered source node and qdra level 1 only at the preregistered sink node
only fully completed strict families contribute endpoints
one physical advance per interval; no fallback, retry, temporal subdivision, tolerance relaxation or direct state mutation
failed intervals terminate that family and preserve the latest committed origin bit-identically
emit only family provenance plus committed H/theta state for selection

response_blind_selection.pair_scope: only UPSHIFT versus DOWNSHIFT twins with the same transfer fraction and accepted step count
response_blind_selection.selected_rung: tightest storage rung with at least one qualifying direction-twin pair; EXACT only for numeric equality of both W_profile and W_root30
response_blind_selection.no_match: Close E07 NO_MATCH without adding rates, steps, nodes or relaxing state thresholds.

qualification_gates: fresh equilibrium control is strict accepted
all candidate intervals have complete mass accounting with |residual|<=1e-12 cm
selected pair, if any, is persisted with all 16 H/theta values before response work
next_if_selected: Preregister GC-RZM06E08 using the immutable E07 pair and the unchanged fixed-Hc probe; response interpretation is bounded to the selected storage rung unless the EXACT rung is selected.
next_if_no_match: Stop the internal-source/sink construction family under this frozen grid and derive a different prospective state coordinate; do not retune retrospectively.
nonclaims: qssdi/qdra are used here as controlled research state-construction channels, not as an admitted production coupling design.
A selected state pair alone is not response-memory evidence.
No second MODFLOW hydraulic state or production coupling change is introduced.
